device_entry.description: 可通过USB、USB RAW、串口、TCP/IP或GPIB进行文本命令通信的通用实验室仪器，如电子测量仪表、源表、电源或分析仪。此类设备通常在实验室中用于远程控制、参数配置、状态读取和测量数据采集。
device_entry.description_en: A generic laboratory instrument that communicates through text-based commands over USB, USB RAW, serial, TCP/IP, or GPIB, such as electronic test instruments, source meters, power supplies, or analyzers. These devices are commonly used in laboratories for remote control, parameter configuration, status readback, and measurement data acquisition.
